method: Three rotating fresh-page trials; fixed synthetic schedule; 330 update-only warmup plus 30 actual production callbacks. Uninstrumented measures only callback duration. Profile mode uses measurement-only HTTP source seams for baseline expiry/analysis/policy/diagnostic timers plus nested method wrappers. COOP/COEP for native timer resolution. Viewport 1280x800 DPR1, generated silent stereo PCM. No human preset. Canvas CPU submission excludes GPU completion.
initialProbeCounterCaveat: Initial probe evolved during the first trial: some initial heap-call totals include post-measurement policy trimming. Initial timing components/expiry governor counters informed hotspot selection; final native-comparison.json and native-saturated.json use uniform counters excluding those trims.
